semantically_equivalent_models.justification: Simplicial embeddings are a type of embedding method, which falls under the broader category of embeddings like graph embeddings in the context of processing graph-structured data.

parent_models.justification: Graph embedding networks are a specific application within the realm of graph neural networks, which encompass various models focusing on processing and understanding graph-structured data.

closest_parent_model.justification: Graph neural network is the broadest model that encompasses the specific techniques of applying neural networks to graph data, including graph embedding networks.

child_models.justification: This model likely uses or incorporates graph embeddings as part of its techniques for encoding graph-structured data.

closest_child_model.justification: This model involves the use of positional and possibly embedding strategies on graph data which aligns closely with the functions of graph embedding networks.

sibling_models.justification: Graph attention networks, like graph embedding networks, are a type of specialized GNN tailored for certain graph-related tasks. They are siblings under the umbrella of graph neural networks but differ in functional approaches.

closest_sibling_model.justification: Of the related models under GNNs, graph attention networks share the most concepts due to their method of processing relational data using attention mechanisms, which correlates closely with embedding strategies.
